Signatures  WPCRL No.1739 of 2025  Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Pavan Kumar Nath, learned counsel for the Petitioner.
2. Mr. S.S. Chauhan, learned DAG with Mr. Vikash Uniyal, learned Brief Holder, for the State of Uttarakhand/1 and 2.

3. The present writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India filed by the Petitioner for quashing/setting-aside the FIR No.304 of 2024, dated 14.06.2024, under Section 420 of IPC, at Police Station SIDCUL, District Haridwar and directing the Respondent nos.1 and 2 not to arrest the Petitioner in connection with the abovementioned F.I.R.
4. Heard.
Issue notice to the Respondent No.3.
Steps to be taken within a week.
Counter affidavit, if any, to be filed by the Respondents within a period of three weeks.

In the interregnum, it is directed that the investigation shall proceed but the present Petitioner shall not be arrested by the Police in pursuance to FIR No.304 of 2024, dated 14.06.2024, under Section 420 of IPC, at Police Station SIDCUL, District Haridwar.

However, he will continue to cooperate with the Investigating Officer of the case and shall remain present before the Investigating Officer, as and when required for production of documents and for recording of his statements.
9. Interim relief application (IA No.1 of 2025) stands disposed of accordingly.

(Ashish Naithani, J.) 29.12.2025 Nitesh/
